name: v1.2.0.9007 - Kilo compatibility, CI preflight, and secure dev prereleases

sections.title: Kilo compatibility, CI preflight, and secure dev prereleases
entries: Localize Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode compatibility skills under the project trust boundary with checksum-managed mirrors and safe migration.
Add one authoritative PR preflight for native targets, module validation, exact base selection, and bounded CI repair.
Restore four-component GitHub prereleases directly from dev with a read-only tag build and protected-main Pages deployment controller.

sections.title: Release, linker, projection, and CI corrections
entries: Restore explicit and resumed vX.Y.Z.build releases, force four-component tags to prerelease status, and preserve stable releases on main.
Accept singular --platform aliases, reject symlinked generation roots, and make Kilo-dependent CI paths portable.
Exclude bytecode caches and stale manifest paths from generated bundles and restore registry-aware skill scanning.

sections.title: Release integrity and regression coverage
entries: Validate complete release payload sets, public release parity, exact tag and branch lineage, Pages artifacts, and API metadata before publication.
Add immutable release-tag, admin-only tag-creation, and protected-dev repository rulesets, plus semantic release-policy tests.
Expand parser, linter, linker, containment, migration, and cross-platform release coverage across all generated adapters.
